Close evidence update 2026-09-07:
- Targeted tests passed on current origin/main worktree: `python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_observability_timeout_9313.py tests/scripts/test_observability_memory_9ea3.py tests/unit/test_gate_peak_rss_9ea3.py -q` -> 50 passed in 137.42s.
- CloudWatch 3h window 2026-09-07T00:29:49Z..03:29:49Z showed completion and no truncation: `probe_ok` 31 datapoints, all max=1; `probe_truncated` 31 datapoints, all max=0; `probe_elapsed_seconds` max=128s under the 240s unit timeout.
- Late/formerly-tail metrics now publish in the same window: `docker_storage_bytes`, `docker_buildkit_cache_bytes`, `docker_buildkit_cache_used_percent`, `docker_unaccounted_bytes`, `container_writable_bytes`, and `container_exited_bytes` each had 25 datapoints with last samples at 20:24 PDT; `journal_bytes`, `var_tmp_bytes`, `var_tmp_used_percent`, `mem_available_percent`, and `container_stats_ok` each had 33 datapoints.
- Alarm surface remeasurement: `rebar-container-writable-usage-high` and `rebar-var-tmp-usage-high` are OK. `rebar-docker-buildkit-cache-high` remains ALARM on a real value (104% > 85%), not on the prior silent truncation shape; the probe diagnosis is therefore no longer incomplete.
- Back-out remains the normal Gerrit/autodeploy path for the landed probe changes (`aaa31f11f3bc` / `84ef284833be`).
